Tuned vs Televizo

November 19, 2026

Televizo, from Andrey Menscikov, is a popular free player for phones, tablets and TVs, with a one-time Premium that removes ads. Tuned is also free on the same devices, with no ads at all. Here is how they compare.

At a glance

TelevizoTuned
Where it runsAndroid phones, tablets and TVsAndroid phones, tablets, Chromebooks, Android TV and Google TV
Playlist typesSeveral playlists (types not listed on the pages we read)Xtream Codes, M3U link or file, MAC portal, Plex, Jellyfin and Emby
TV guideEPGXMLTV guide as a list or a full grid, with reminders
Catch-upYesYes, on Xtream servers that keep recordings
RecordingNot stated by the developerYes, live and from the guide (Premium)
Pause and rewind live TVNot stated by the developerYes, up to an hour kept on the device (Premium)
Several channels at onceNot stated by the developerNo, on purpose: one stream connection at a time
Casting to a TVChromecast (the developer calls it limited)Chromecast and DLNA, phone as remote
Picture-in-pictureNot stated by the developerYes
Offline downloadsNot stated by the developerFilms and episodes, whole seasons too (more than 3 at a time is Premium)
Profiles and parental controlsParental control (Premium)Up to 6 profiles, kids profiles and PINs (Premium); adult categories locked behind a PIN
TraktNot stated by the developerTrakt and Simkl; Trakt can import watched history (Premium)
Film and show detailsNot stated by the developerTMDB ratings, trailers, cast and actor pages, saved on the device
SubtitlesChoose video, audio and subtitle tracksFull caption styling, timing fix, and subtitle search for films and episodes
AdsYes, removed by PremiumNone, ever
PriceFree with ads; Premium is a one-time purchase for 5 devices (price not stated)Free; Premium US$9.99 a year with a 7-day trial, or US$24.99 once

"Not stated by the developer" means we couldn't find it on the developer's own pages or store listing. It may still be there, so check before you rule it out.

Price

Televizo is free with ads. Premium is a one-time purchase that removes them and adds parental control, backup and more, on up to five devices with a Televizo account, and you can try it free for an hour. The developer's page doesn't give the price. Tuned has no ads in either version; Premium is US$9.99 a year with a 7-day trial or US$24.99 once.

Tuned's prices are what Google Play charges in the United States; Play shows them in your own currency. Premium covers up to three devices, and a Tuned account can add more.

Where Televizo is ahead

  • Five devices on one Premium purchase, against Tuned's three (a Tuned account can add more).
  • A long-established app with millions of installs.

Where Tuned is ahead

  • No ads, free or paid.
  • Recording, pause and rewind live TV, and offline downloads.
  • A full grid guide, reminders and a Live events page.
  • Film and show pages, Trakt and subtitle search.

What Tuned does that most players don't

  • Opens straight to your channels. The playlist and guide live on the device, so the app shows channels the moment it opens and keeps them fresh in the background. Lists page straight from the database, so a playlist with tens of thousands of streams scrolls smoothly.
  • One stream connection, ever. The player, downloads, recordings, channel scans and backup copies take turns on a single connection, and anything in the background waits while you watch. Providers limit connections per account, and Tuned never uses a second one.
  • Live events from your guide. Today's games and fights are pulled out of the guide into one page. Tune finds a working English stream for an event, one channel at a time, and you can follow a team, league or fighter to get an alert before they play.
  • Backup copies and dead channels. When a channel has several copies, Tuned tries the next one if the first won't play, and a channel scan hides channels that never work, without blaming them for a slow internet connection or a busy server.
  • Real names over numbers. Episodes show their real titles from TMDB rather than "S1 E1", and tapping an actor opens everything they've been in, with what's in your playlist marked.
  • Sign in on a TV with your phone. Scan a QR code on the TV and type the login on your phone instead of with the remote.

Which one to pick

If you want a simple free player and don't mind ads, Televizo works. If you'd rather never see an ad, and want recording, live pause and downloads, try Tuned.

Sources

Checked on 19 November 2026. Features and prices change, so check the developer's page before you buy.
